boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named stops across UMBC’s neighboring Arbutus commercial corridors, each identified in UMBC’s current community guide.

cards.title: Catch a film at Hollywood Cinema 4
cards.subtitle: Oregon Avenue corridor, Arbutus
cards.notes: Use the Arbutus Line stop at Sulphur Spring Road and Selma Avenue, then confirm the current film schedule directly before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A named four-screen cinema on Oregon Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: UMBC lists Hollywood Cinema 4 at 5509 Oregon Avenue in Arbutus and identifies the nearby Arbutus Line stop.
cards.source_title: Extend Beyond Campus — UMBC Office of Government Relations and Community Affairs
cards.access_notes: UMBC lists the nearby Arbutus Line stop as Sulphur Spring Road & Selma Avenue; confirm showtimes and admission before visiting.
